title: A father and daughter bring her notebook to life with AI: a falling-sand sandbox built with Claude
author: ARA_Makes
selftext:
*Disclosure: this is partly promotion, but it's also a project my daughter and I are doing together. Her engagement keeps her excited to do more.*

I built this with my daughter Ara. She wrote a list for a sandbox game on a notebook page: sand, water, oil, leaves, fire, rain, steam, buildings, lava, ice, wood, walls and stone. Claude helped us turn that list into a playable game in one Sunday afternoon.

**What it is:** a falling-sand sandbox, where every grain and drop follows a few simple rules (a cellular-automata simulation). Lava turns water to steam and cools into stone. Oil floats on water and burns. Ice freezes water. Each of Ara's ideas became a rule we had to decide how to write.

**How Claude helped:**

* **Reading the notebook:** Ara's notebook pages were photographed, and Claude read the handwritten list and her notes from the images. Those notes became the materials and rules for the game.
* **Writing the game code:** Claude co-wrote the simulation code. The commit history shows Claude Opus 5.5 as co-author on the project's commits. Claude also turned each of Ara's words into a rule, such as lava turning water to steam.
* **Checking against her page:** Ara went through her page one word at a time, on camera, and checked that the game did what she'd written. Where it didn't match, Claude helped us fix it, and she checked again.
* **Making the videos:** Claude helped build the video pipeline in our studio repo, including scripts that assemble each episode and cut the YouTube Shorts.
* **Building the toolset:** Claude helped write the tools that make the videos, such as the recording, caption and music steps, and the documentation for them.

**Free to try:** open [aramakes.github.io/ara-games](http://aramakes.github.io/ara-games) in a browser. It's free, with no ads.

**Video of the build and her check:** [https://youtu.be/w5TX0Nu4XVQ](https://youtu.be/w5TX0Nu4XVQ)  
**Channel:** [https://www.youtube.com/@ARA\_Makes](https://www.youtube.com/@ARA_Makes)

We have more games and more videos coming. The videos, the tools that make them and even a recording booth are built with AI tools. The aim is the same as with this game: she comes up with the ideas, and we work out how to make them real.

I wanted her to see that the imagination is the hard part, and that a computer can turn it into something you can play. She got to decide what the rules should be, and she had to test whether they worked.
